कृत्यायु.hi: कृत्यायु, बटुक भैरवका एक नाम (इस चालीसाकी नामावलीमें)
कृत्यायु.en: Kṛtyāyu, a name of Baṭuka Bhairava (in this Chālīsā’s list of his names)

छीजनको.en: Chījana, the name of a place

छीतरमल.en: Chītaramala, the poet of this Chālīsā

तेश.en: part of "Trailateśa", a name of Bhairava

त्रैल.en: part of "Trailateśa", a name of Bhairava

दसपाण.en: Daśapāṇa, "the ten-handed": a name of Bhairava

लम्ब.hi: लम्ब (लम्बे, विशाल), भैरवजीका एक नाम (इस चालीसामें)
लम्ब.en: Lamba, ‘the long, the large’, a name of Bhairava (in this Chālīsā)

सुनन्द.en: Sunanda, a name of Baṭuka Bhairava
